_meta.what: Mails Global sent to every player on a given day; replay_mails.py delivers each once history reaches its date. `by_days`: [[up to N days played, count], ..., [null, count]] of `item`, days counted in history from the replay start to the mail's date.

mails.title: Guaranteed NV Summon Ticket
mails.message: A Guaranteed NV Summon Ticket for every player. Use it on the Guaranteed NV Summon for one of five selected NV units.
